EC1: Exclusion Criteria: coronary artery disease [OR], diabetes mellitus [OR], contraindications [OR] to cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR), weight >350 lbs [OR], inability to lie flat for imaging [OR], anemia [OR], contraindications to regadenoson [OR] or aminophylline
EC2: HEALTHY: known cardiovascular disease [OR], cardiac risk factors [OR] or use of cardiac medications
EC3: HYPERTENSIVE: known cardiovascular disease [OR] or risk factors aside from hypertension [OR] or use of cardiac medications
EC4: HFpEF: prior history of LVEF below 50% [OR], acute decompensated HF [OR], moderate [OR] or greater valvular disease [OR], significant cardiac arrhythmias [OR], pericardial disease [OR], congenital heart disease [OR], primary pulmonary hypertension
